scope: CPU-only rectangular support-height controller and no-surface compatibility. No GPU test or catalog activation performed.

height_test.kitchen_source: explicit_no_surface_fixture; kitchen_meadow.scene did not yet exist at test time

verified_behavior: Keeps eye_height above current rectangular support while ascending and descending twelve 0.16 m risers.
Checks support coverage for the whole constrained movement segment, not just its endpoint; a 2 mm gap inside an 8 cm substep blocks movement.
A pose already in a gap or at an unsupported eye elevation does not snap to a nearby floor.
Overlapping levels retain the current supported height; a different level must connect by a shared edge.
Rejects upward/downward height changes beyond their separate configured limits.
Ignores requested vertical displacement in supported mode; this controller has no jump or flight.
Sweeps supported XY movement against discs/capsules so a long frame movement cannot skip an 8 mm obstacle.
Preserves original float operation order and XYZ results for scenes with no surfaces.
Retains far_clip=200 default and accepts a 1000 m profile with inline comments.
Rejects nonfinite values, malformed/trailing data, invalid dimensions/radii, unsupported/obstructed supported spawn and excessive movement inputs.

format.surface: surface xmin ymin xmax ymax support_z
format.bounds: bounds xmin xmax ymin ymax (existing order, different from surface)
format.step_limits: nonnegative maximum upward and downward transitions in metres

stair_export.spawn_eye_z_rule: support_z at spawn XY + eye_height; current approach spawn is z=1.55.

current_spawn_camera.status: Semilla de proyección analítica ajustada a6 hitos rígidos aproximados; no verificada mediante render.

stair_export.corridor_note: Use ±0.72 centre bounds, leaving 0.18 m agent radius plus 0.03 m margin inside the ±0.93 support width. Top bound ends at y=5.0, before support edge 5.2.
stair_export.endpoint_note: At an exact shared edge the current supported height remains valid until movement enters the next tread; no unconditional highest-surface snap. This is state-aware closed contact, not a stateless half-open highest-floor query.
stair_export.exporter_instruction: Map each dream_navigation.support_surfaces xyxy_m/support_z_m to one surface line. Round adjacent endpoints consistently to six decimal places; write eye_height, step_limits and centre-corridor bounds once. Do not mark catalog playable until integration and actual traversal are checked.

limitations: Axis-aligned constant-height rectangles only: no slopes, jumping, gravity or arbitrary mesh collision.
Height-changing surfaces must share an edge; author navigation patches as a partition rather than an overlapping lower floor beneath a raised step.
Swept obstacle contacts conservatively block the substep; no new continuous slide solver is implemented.
No rendering, catalog change, scene export or real gameplay traversal was performed in this subtask.
